subject: Post-call: technical deep dive / availability accordion proposal
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Anna Schultz <anna@playfin.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: technical deep dive / availability accordion proposal

Hi Anna / Playfin team —

Thanks again for the call today — great context on your realtime analytics use case and the latency/cost sensitivity on inference. Quick recap:
- Primary need: scale embeddings + short-form generation for alert summaries (100k reqs/day, median response target ~220ms).
- Data constraints: PII redaction required; KMS-backed keys preferred.
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency under 400ms, predictable cost per 1k requests, and audit logs for retention 6+ months.

Next step: technical deep dive with our Solutions Engineer to walk the infra plan, perf profile, and a short pilot scope. To make scheduling less painful across your EU/US/APAC contributors, I sketched an "availability accordion" that expands and compresses weekly windows so the team in each region gets prime hours in rotation. High-level idea: three-week cycle where each week favors a different region, with an overlapping 60-minute bridge window for cross-region stakeholders.

Proposed minimal options (pick one or send alternatives):
- Option A (Week 1: US-friendly): Tue 17:00–18:00 PDT / Wed 00:00–01:00 UTC (works for US lead + EU evening)
- Option B (Week 2: EU-friendly): Wed 15:00–16:00 CEST / Wed 13:00–14:00 UTC (better for EU mornings)
- Option C (Week 3: APAC-friendly): Thu 09:00–10:00 AEST / Thu 23:00–00:00 UTC (APAC mornings)

If you'd rather pick fixed times, send your 2–3 preferred windows and I will build the 3-week accordion and circulate a recurring invite that alternates the primary slot each week. I attached a one-pager mutual-action-plan (stub) and our architecture diagram for context.

Attaching: mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf, redwood-arch-diagram.png

If it helps, I can also copy Karthik (SE) to propose deep-dive agenda items (perf targets, sample payloads, VPC options).

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

- We generally prefer mornings in CET. Late evenings UTC are tougher for our product folks.

From the options you listed, Option B (Wed 15:00–16:00 CEST) is the most realistic. A couple other windows that work for us if you need alternatives:
- Tue 09:30–10:30 CEST (works for our EU PM + Tom if he shifts)
- Thu 14:00–15:00 CEST (backup)

Can you propose a three-week pattern that keeps one EU-centric week and rotates US/APAC weeks? Also, we have a procurement checkpoint on 2026-09-22, so if we could land a kickoff before then that would be ideal.

Anna — perfect, thanks for the quick clarity and for looping Tom in. Based on your preference for EU mornings, here's the concrete 3-week accordion that preserves an EU-friendly primary slot each cycle and rotates US/APAC as the secondary primaries: 

Week A (EU-priority) — Primary: Wed 15:00–16:00 CEST (13:00–14:00 UTC)
Week B (US-priority) — Primary: Tue 17:00–18:00 PDT (00:00–01:00 UTC)
Week C (APAC-priority) — Primary: Thu 09:30–10:30 AEST (23:30–00:30 UTC previous day)

Each meeting will include a 15-minute shared bridge at the top of the hour for stakeholders who cannot attend the primary window; the SE will record the session and upload the recording if someone has to miss due to timezone conflicts.

To meet your procurement checkpoint on 2026-09-22, I can schedule the first session during Week A on Wed 2026-09-16 15:00 CEST (which is tomorrow) — short notice, I know. If that doesn't work, the next EU-priority slot is Wed 2026-09-23 which is after your checkpoint.

Action items:
- Anna / Tom: confirm whether you can do Wed 2026-09-16 15:00 CEST (tomorrow).
- If not possible, confirm best alternative from the two EU windows you suggested (Tue 09:30–10:30 CEST or Thu 14:00–15:00 CEST) and I will lock the recurring 3-week pattern.

Karthik — can you confirm you'll be available for a deep dive in the Week A slot (tomorrow) or Wed 2026-09-23 if we pick the later start? I'll draft a calendar invite once Anna confirms.

Thanks —
Ben
